notes: Address confirmed 2026-09-10 from the church's own site footer and Times & Location page: 18280 S. La Canada (Drive), Sahuarita AZ 85629, one mile north of Duval Mine Road off I-19; geocode reset to missing, run tools/geocode.py. Affiliation settled: the 'Our Stand' page says 'We are an independent, fundamental, Bible-preaching church that uses only traditional, Christ-honoring music', so this is an independent Baptist church, not SBC. (A FaithStreet listing labels it General Association of Regular Baptist Churches; that is a third-party claim the church's own site does not make.) Sole pastor is John W. Leonard, Senior Pastor since May 2005 - International Baptist College BA 1989, Bob Jones University MA in Pastoral Studies 1992, previously Associate Pastor at Valley Bible Church Phoenix and Senior Pastor of Faith Baptist Church, Yuma. No other pastoral staff are listed. LIKELY NOT REVIEWABLE: the site's Sermons page has no content at all, the Videos page holds a single Vimeo clip of special music by Pastor and Mrs. Leonard, and no YouTube channel, podcast or SermonAudio broadcaster was found. The church has a Facebook page (facebook.com/CornerstoneBaptistChurchAZ) which could not be read without a login - someone with a browser session should check whether services are streamed there before writing this church off.
